entities.name: IoOpenDeviceRegistryKey
entities.description: Opens a device-specific registry key for a device object and returns a handle to the key.

entities.name: IoOpenDriverRegistryKey
entities.description: Opens the registry key for a driver. Used in WDM drivers with DRIVER_REGKEY_TYPE parameter.

entities.name: SERVICE_REGISTRY_STATE_TYPE
entities.description: Service registry state type. These registry values supplied by the INF in the Parameters subkey for the service should only be read at runtime and not modified. They should be treated as read only. If the registry values supplied by the INF are default settings that can be overwritten at runtime, the override values should be written into the Internal service registry state or Shared service registry state for the service. When retrieving the settings, the setting can be looked for first in the mutable state. If it does not exist there, then the setting can be looked for in the immutable state. RtlQueryRegistryValueWithFallback can be used to help query settings such as these that have an override and a default value.

entities.name: WdfDriverOpenPersistentStateRegistryKey
entities.description: The WdfDriverOpenPersistentStateRegistryKey function opens a registry key where the driver can store persistent state information.

entities.name: IoGetDeviceDirectory
entities.description: IoGetDeviceDirectory 例程返回指向指定设备对象目录的句柄，驱动程序可使用该句柄在目录中读写文件。该函数在 WDM 中使用，DirectoryType 参数应设置为 DeviceDirectoryData。

entities.name: IoGetDriverDirectory
entities.description: 返回指向驱动程序目录的句柄，驱动程序可从中读取和写入文件。该目录中的文件适用于特定的驱动程序对象。适用于 WDM 和 KMDF 驱动开发。

entities.name: GetServiceDirectory
entities.description: Retrieves the directory path for service persistent state. Used by Win32 services to access their persistent state directory when the eDirectoryType parameter is set to ServiceDirectoryPersistentState.

entities.name: WdfDeviceQueryInterfaceProperty
entities.description: Retrieves a property from the device interface for a WDF device. Available in Windows 8.1 and later.

entities.name: WdfDeviceAllocAndQueryInterfaceProperty
entities.description: Allocates and queries an interface property for a device object. Available in Windows 8.1 and later.

entities.name: REG_SZ
entities.description: Windows 注册表数据类型常量，表示以 NULL 结尾的字符串值。内核模式代码读取设备路径时需在值前添加\??\前缀。

entities.name: DRIVER_ISOLATION_VIOLATION
entities.description: Registry operations should only use key handles returned from WDF or WDM APIs. Detected creation of unisolated registry key \REGISTRY\MACHINE\SYSTEM\SomeKeyThatShouldNotExist. Consider running Device Fundamentals tests with DV driver isolation checks enabled. Starting with Windows 11 24H2, reset throttling using: verifier /dif 33 /action 1

entities.name: WDF_DEVICE_INTERFACE_PROPERTY_DATA
entities.description: 结构体用于定义设备接口属性数据，包含属性键和属性值等成员

entities.name: WDF_DEVICE_INTERFACE_PROPERTY_DATA_INIT
entities.description: 用于初始化WDF_DEVICE_INTERFACE_PROPERTY_DATA结构体的宏，设置设备接口属性数据

entities.name: NT_TARGET_VERSION
entities.description: 指定驱动程序的目标操作系统版本。设置为驱动程序支持的最低Windows版本。例如，Windows 10驱动程序应支持Windows 10及更高版本。参考相关主题以确保驱动程序包支持多个Windows版本。

entities.name: PWTS_SESSION_INFO
entities.description: 指向 WTS_SESSION_INFO 结构体数组的指针类型，用于 WTSEnumerateSessions 等函数

entities.name: WTSFreeMemory
entities.description: 释放由WTSQuerySessionInformation等函数分配的内存块。

entities.name: STAMPINF_VERSION
entities.description: Specifies the date that is written in the INF DriverVer directive. The format is month/day/year (e.g., 10/20/2011). Use an asterisk (*) to specify the current date. When enabled, the Driver Version Directive Date must not be empty.

entities.name: WDTF_TARGET
entities.description: Windows Desktop Tool Foundation target structure
